summary: Reject action deletes shared EXPRESSES edge, orphaning accepted sibling tags

entries.content: Discovered while auditing 53a46a8d (concept ID format mismatch). The premise of 53a46a8d was incorrect — bare IDs in staged_tags are BY DESIGN (apply-time prefixing per docs/concept-hierarchy/design.md:32 and confirmed by scripts/review_tags.py:90-123, guru-review/server/src/apply.ts:82-94). Live DB verification: 30,294 of 30,349 accepted tags have matching EXPRESSES edges (99.9% coverage).

55 accepted tags are missing their EXPRESSES edges. ALL 55 have a rejected sibling for the same (chunk_id, concept_id) pair from a different model. The reject action deletes the shared edge unconditionally, even when an accepted sibling tag still supports it.

All 55 are in christian_mysticism (49) and buddhism (6). All have siblings of the form [(accepted, 1), (rejected, 1)] across models Qwen3.5-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf and qwen-3-4b-guru-v3-Q4_K_M.ggfu / Carnice-9b.

This is an apply-path defect in the review app's reject logic: when a tag is rejected, the apply script deletes the EXPRESSES edge without checking whether other accepted tags still reference the same (chunk, concept) pair. Fix: check for surviving accepted tags before deleting the edge.
